Keep the scripted evidence boundary and lettering visible.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.045, 0.78, 0.91, 0.18 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "question", "box": [ 0.14651483333333332, 0.22419999999999998, 0.11093333333333336, 0.25600000000000006 ], "color": "amber", "focus": true, "label": "SAME PROVIDER?", "label_box": [ 0.09640000000000001, 0.4862, 0.211163, 0.085 ] }, { "asset": "question", "box": [ 0.4102478333333333, 0.22419999999999998, 0.11093333333333336, 0.25600000000000006 ], "color": "amber", "focus": true, "label": "SAME TRAINING?", "label_box": [ 0.360133, 0.4862, 0.211163, 0.085 ] }, { "asset": "question", "box": [ 0.6739818333333333, 0.22419999999999998, 0.11093333333333336, 0.25600000000000006 ], "color": "amber", "focus": true, "label": "CROSS-READING?", "label_box": [ 0.623867, 0.4862, 0.211163, 0.085 ] } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "row", "source": "
**Frame:** Curt's pen hovers over the gap between the lanes. He writes three labels in the gap and boxes each with a question mark: `SAME PROVIDER?` (the report's inference), `SAME TRAINING?` (unknown), `EITHER ONE READ THE OTHER?` (no evidence either way). No line crosses.

**Dialogue — CURT:**
> Probably distinct. That is their finding. It is not the same as unrelated.

**Provenance:** `documented` + `inferred` — the distinct-swarm assessment and the OpenAI attribution are `CW-REPORT`'s, stated by its authors as inferences; the three questions are the project's and are left open.

", "title": "Three cross-lane questions have no connecting arrows" } }
